_about: The Story screen's timeline (1 to 2 October 2026, UK time, from file timestamps). Full version: docs/history.md.

steps.title: The starting point
steps.text: The course gave us a notebook with a working agent engine, but on made-up data: a pretend retailer, in pounds.

steps.title: Cut the AI cost
steps.text: Measured where the tokens went. Shorter rulebook and tool menu: 32% less fixed cost per round on the free Groq plan.

steps.title: Turn the brief into a plan
steps.text: 18 requirements, 13 steps anyone can follow. Key decision: keep the engine, add a new Section 6.

steps.title: Build Section 6
steps.text: Real AdventureWorks data, read-only. Five tools, four guardrails, a new scorecard, the weekly briefing, a planted anomaly to rehearse.

steps.title: A demo app
steps.text: The same agent behind a small web server: Live AI, Replay of recorded runs, and Dry run for testing. 27 automatic checks.

steps.title: Product and design
steps.text: Who it's for and what success looks like. The look: a hand-lettered cassette J-card, the demo as a six-minute mixtape.

steps.title: Real AI runs, recorded
steps.text: Groq's daily allowance ran out, so OpenAI takes over automatically. Every demo question recorded live; scorecard 6 of 7 at first.

steps.title: Clear for every audience
steps.text: Fixed a briefing stall, added Stakeholder and Developer views, spoken explanations with live captions, and this online copy.

steps.title: Checked against the brief
steps.text: Every line of the brief, with evidence. Fixed a returns answer, added cost, recorded the planted anomaly. Scorecard 7 of 7.

steps.title: A finished product
steps.text: A Home screen with every area, a floating Ask chat that streams answers and links the blog, API and code, the blog and API reference, and every track re-recorded live.

steps.title: Final touches
steps.text: A last read-through of every screen and the write-up, then a clean check that the project downloads and runs on a fresh PC.
